brief:
Israeli opposition leaders have joined forces in a coordinated effort to remove Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu from power, according to Al Jazeera English. The alignment represents a significant consolidation of political forces across the Israeli opposition spectrum.

Details of the specific tactics and timeline for the unified campaign were not immediately clear. The development comes amid ongoing political tensions in Israel.
dek: Jerusalem Daily: Israeli opposition leaders unite to drive out Netanyahu…
title: Israeli opposition leaders unite against Netanyahu
